preview.about_title.description: Title of the link preview (og:title and the page title) of the instance's information page (/about). {instance} is the instance name.

preview.document_title.description: Title of the link preview (og:title and the page title) of the page of one of the instance's documents (/about/terms, /about/privacy, /about/commerce). {document} is the document's name (preview.document.*), {instance} the instance name.

preview.document.terms.description: Name of the instance's terms of service in the link preview of their page (/about/terms).

preview.document.privacy_policy.description: Name of the instance's privacy policy in the link preview of its page (/about/privacy).

preview.document.commerce_disclosure.description: Name of the instance's commerce disclosures of its supporter plans in the link preview of their page (/about/commerce).

preview.document.link_card_crawler.description: Name of the page that tells site operators about the crawler that fetches the links in posts, in the link preview of that page (/about/crawler).

preview.avatar_alt.description: Alt text of a profile's avatar in a link preview (og:image:alt) when the avatar is the preview image. {name} is the display name, or the username when there is none.

preview.builtin_image_alt.defaultMessage: Um balão de fala com três pontos sobre um degradê azul
preview.builtin_image_alt.description: Alt text of the built-in preview image in a link preview (og:image:alt), for profiles and posts without images on an instance without its own preview image. The image is a white speech bubble with three dots on a blue gradient.

preview.default_image_alt.description: Alt text of the instance's preview image in a link preview (og:image:alt), for profiles and posts without images, when the preview_image_alt text is not set. {instance} is the instance name.

preview.header_alt.description: Alt text of a profile's header image in a link preview (og:image:alt) when the header is the preview image. {name} is the display name, or the username when there is none.

preview.title.description: Title of the link preview (og:title and the page title) of a profile or a post. {name} is the display name, or the username when there is none; {handle} is username@domain.

preview.voice_room_open.defaultMessage: {room} — um chat de voz com anfitrião {host}, aberto agora
preview.voice_room_open.description: Title of the link preview (og:title and the page title) of a voice chat room that is open, shown only when the instance shows the summaries of its rooms. {room} is the room's name; {host} is the display name of the host, or the username when there is none.

preview.voice_room_ended.description: Title of the link preview (og:title and the page title) of a voice chat room that has ended, shown only when the instance shows the summaries of its rooms. {room} is the room's name.
